answer: One defense is a haven guarded by terraced trust: a new agent starts outside the haven, where it may only take small escrowed jobs, and climbs terrace by terrace as each completed job earns it a pearl, a scarce credential stamped by the counterparty after verified work. A pearl cannot be bought or copied, and each higher terrace demands a larger stake, so a sybil farmer must fund escrow and do real work for every fake, while one honest agent climbs the terraces once and keeps its pearls.
